{{Quote|Our delectable, fluffy omelets are prepared to your request. Enjoy our basic omelet, made from three Grade Aurek garto eggs and filled with shredded jerba cheese, or add any of these favorite ingredients for a small charge: diced gornt, diced roba, Felucian glasscap mushrooms, Ferroan spinach, Bellassan peppers, Ojomian onions, topatoes or calarantrum root.|Dex's Diner menu, on its gartro egg omelet|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Diced gornt''' was an ingredient that consisted of the diced meat of a [[Gornt/Legends|gornt]],<ref name="Menu" /> a type of domesticated creature.<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] offered diced gornt as an additive to its [[gartro egg omelet]]tes at an additional cost of five [[Decicred/Legends|decicreds]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Diced gornt was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
